title: Prohibition of Anger
arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه و سلم أَوْصِنِي. قَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ، فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ: لَا تَغْضَبْ\
english_translation: From Abū Hurayrah (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) that a man said to the Prophet (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam), 'Advise me.' He said, 'Do not become angry' and (the man) repeated his request a number of times and he said, 'Do not become angry.'
